outcome: Prevalence of diabetes first detected in pregnancy
cohort: 2000 pregnant patients who underwent a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) between January 2016 and April 2016 and had no known pre-conception diabetes
finding: Newly detected T2DM in pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to GDM and no diabetes, including pre-eclampsia, preterm delivery, cesarean section, macrosomia, LGA, and neonatal ICU admissions.
